room.source: Read from a house repertory plot and section. Not measured.

notes: A large proscenium house: four electrics and a cyc electric, two pairs of pro slots, three ceiling catwalks and a balcony rail. 201 units.
Built from a real house's repertory plot, with the name taken off. Front-of-house heights are approximate and nothing here was measured.

Every unit is focused straight down at the deck below it. That is a stand-in, so throws and pools compute; the house focus is not on the plot. Re-aim one by dragging its ring, or Shift-drag its body when the ring is hidden underneath.
The curved front-of-house runs are drawn as straight legs sharing one name. Booms are left off: the designer places them per show.
It is a big drawing. At 1/4" = 1'-0" it needs a 36" x 48" sheet (ARCH E); on ARCH D, print it at 1/8".
